tools.name: arxiv_search
tools.description: Use when you need to discover arXiv e-prints by keyword, title, author or field query: pass any arXiv search_query string (e.g. "transformer attention", "au:vaswani", "ti:\"attention is all you need\"", "cat:cs.LG AND all:diffusion"). Returns up to 25 papers with id, title, summary, authors (names +

tools.name: arxiv_paper
tools.description: Use when you have an arXiv id (new-style like 1706.03762 or with version 1706.03762v7, or old-style like hep-ex/0307015) and need its public metadata card: title, abstract/summary, authors with affiliations (emails removed), primary category, all categories, published and updated timestamps, author

tools.name: arxiv_abs
tools.description: Use when you need a compact abstract card for an arXiv id without full affiliation/journal/comment fields: returns id, title, summary, author names only, primary category, published/updated, absUrl and pdfUrl. Same id rules as /v1/arxiv/paper. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.002 per successful call

tools.name: arxiv_category
tools.description: Use when you want the latest or relevance-ranked papers in one arXiv subject class: pass cat (e.g. cs.AI, quant-ph, stat.ML). Returns up to 25 papers with the same fields as search, plus totalResults for paging. Default sort is submittedDate descending (newest first). Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $
